suggestions: I'm grateful for the quiet stillness before Subuh that lets me start the day with a calm heart and clear mind.
I'm thankful for a clean pull request approval without endless rounds of review comments.
I'm grateful for the comforting aroma of morning rain paired with a warm cup of teh tarik before diving into work.
I'm thankful for finally tracking down and fixing that elusive bug that has been lingering in the codebase all week.
I'm grateful for the rezeki of a stable job that challenges my problem-solving skills and provides for my family.
I'm thankful for the midday prayer break that allows me to step away from screens and reset mentally.
I'm grateful for a completely smooth production deployment on a Friday with zero rollback alerts.
I'm thankful for a late-night lepak session with close friends to laugh and decompress after a demanding sprint.
I'm grateful for the flexibility to work remotely and skip the heavy rush hour traffic.
I'm thankful for supportive teammates who are always willing to jump on a quick huddle to unblock a complex task.
I'm grateful for a delicious home-cooked meal waiting for me after a mentally exhausting day.
I'm thankful for the barakah in my time today, allowing me to balance deep focus at work with quality moments at home.
I'm grateful for finding clear, well-written documentation right when I felt stuck on a new framework.
I'm thankful for a peaceful evening walk after Asr to clear my head and stretch after hours of sitting.
I'm grateful for continuous personal growth, looking back at code I wrote years ago and realizing how far I've come.
